themes: Every messenger called to worship Allah
summary_for_children: Ash-Shu'ara tells of Musa and Pharaoh, Ibrahim and his people, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Lut and Shu'ayb. Each called people to worship Allah, and each story ends by reminding us that Allah is Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
environment_concept: Seven shores: towering walls of water either side of a path (26:63), a meadow of many noble kinds (26:7), rock-cut homes, empty (26:149) and a thicket by a market with scales (26:176-183).
architecture_and_scenery: A Nile palace terrace, a parted sea, Ibrahim's town of idols, an ark yard, the high towers of 'Ad, rock-cut homes of Thamud, Lut's town and the thicket of Madyan, linked by a coastal road.

palette.lighting: Changing light at each shore: palace gold, sea blue, rock red, thicket green
palette.atmosphere: Wind on the coast, waves, and quiet between each settlement

areas.name: Towering Waves
areas.description: Sea walls like mountains either side of a path.

areas.name: Earth of Noble Kinds
areas.description: A meadow of many plant kinds at the coast road's start.

areas.name: Homes in the Mountains
areas.description: Rock-cut homes of Thamud, empty and silent.

areas.name: Thicket of Madyan
areas.description: A dense thicket by a marketplace with scales.

activities.name: Full measure
activities.description: Carry the weights to the scale and give full measure.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: The refrain
activities.description: Each shore ends with 26:8-9 read in Arabic; collect each refrain to light the coast road.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Noble kinds
activities.description: Plant three beds; each blooms with a different kind.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration repeats the surah's own structure: each shore, its ayahs, then the refrain. No messenger or person is shown or voiced.

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (carved, market, olives, orchard, seaPath) with 2 hands-on activities in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
